subject.title: xurl skill: add confirm-before-post enforcement and audit log instructions

question: Should xurl be hardened as a bundled OpenClaw skill now, or should the safety contract move with xurl to ClawHub/external ownership before this issue is implemented?
rationale: The issue asks for enforcement and audit behavior around public/account-affecting writes, but current docs make skill prompts advisory and the open trim PR may remove xurl from the bundled core surface.

options.title: Approve The Xurl Safety Contract First
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide the confirm-before-write scope, audit path/retention/redaction, and whether the policy applies in core or in a ClawHub-owned xurl package.

options.title: Resolve By Externalizing Xurl
options.body: If xurl should leave core, land a safe externalization path and close this only after the external skill/package carries the accepted safety policy.

options.title: Accept SKILL.md-Only Guidance
options.body: Add instruction text only, accepting that it improves model guidance but does not create a hard write-enforcement boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve The Xurl Safety Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide the confirm-before-write scope, audit path/retention/redaction, and whether the policy applies in core or in a ClawHub-owned xurl package.
